changeSet.author: taurus
changeSet.comment: The inventory proforma was replaced by the loan sheet: its PDFs are released to the media cleanup, which removes the files once they are no longer active, and its export log is dropped.
changeSet.sql:
UPDATE media_asset media SET deleted = TRUE, status = 'DELETED', edit_by = 'system', edit_date = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, entity_version = media.entity_version + 1 WHERE media.deleted = FALSE AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM inventory_report_export export WHERE export.media_asset_id = media.id) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sheet_music_media WHERE media_asset_id = media.id AND deleted = FALSE) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM upload_job WHERE source_media_asset_id = media.id AND deleted = FALSE) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM inventory_item_photo WHERE media_asset_id = media.id AND deleted = FALSE) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM inventory_return_photo WHERE media_asset_id = media.id AND deleted = FALSE) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM inventory_loan_sheet_export WHERE media_asset_id = media.id AND deleted = FALSE) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM inventory_issue_photo WHERE media_asset_id = media.id AND deleted = FALSE) AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM financial_movement_attachment WHERE media_asset_id = media.id AND deleted = FALSE AND active = TRUE );
DROP TABLE inventory_report_export;
